name: Monte open data
about: The lesson content behind monte.markets as static JSON: business statistics topics, a glossary, a formula sheet with worked examples, and recommended free sources. No key needed, read only.
license: Free to use with a link to monte.markets.

endpoints.about: Every topic: the idea in one paragraph, why it matters, its formulas, a memory hook, the common trap and its page.
The glossary: each term with its meaning, an example and its topic.
The formula sheet by topic, each row with a worked example.
Free courses, books, videos and references, with why each is worth it and the date it was checked.
